_doc: The last crisis (src/systems/lastCrisis.js): the age's climax, aimed at a House that has come to dominate the world. While the player's crowns hold a large share of the world's towns or armies (or the player is an emperor, systems/highCrowns.js), a reckoning gathers week by week; held for holdYears it breaks as one of three kinds (horde, crusade, breakaway) chosen to fit the world. Survived: a Golden Age named for the House. Failed: a Dark Age, the realm broken into successor states. At most once per long age (ageYears). Times in years of 120 days unless named *Days. Every roll is a hash of the world seed (no shared RNG). {tokens} are filled by the system.
_dominance: dominant when the House's crowns hold townShare of the world's towns, or a blend (half towns, half arms) of share, or a coalition might of power — AND at least lead x the towns of the next greatest realm outside its crowns; an emperor's bars are all x emperorEase. Tuned by the endgame soak (src/__tests__/endgame.soak.test.js).

horde: Fishermen off the far coasts speak of sails without number beyond the edge of the charts, and of {people} who say the world's great crown is theirs to break.
A burning star hangs over {realm} for forty nights. In the harbours they say {people} are gathering, and that it is {house} they are coming for.
Envoys of {people} were seen at the courts of {realm}'s neighbours, counting {house}'s towns on their fingers.
crusade: Preachers walk the roads of the other faiths crying that {house} has grown too great for God's patience.
In the temples beyond {realm}'s borders the priests read out {house}'s sins on every holy day.
A holy man of the {faith} has a vision: a crown of {realm} trodden into the mud. The pilgrims carry it everywhere.
breakaway: In the old halls of {old}, men drink to the true blood and turn their cups upside down when {house} is named.
A young man who calls himself {pretender} of the line of {old} is sheltered from lord to lord in {realm}'s far provinces.
Coins of the old kings of {old} turn up in the markets of {realm}'s far towns, freshly polished.

horde: The reckoning has come: {people} land within striking distance of {realm}, the greatest host the age has seen, and they march on the House of {house}.
crusade: {members} proclaim a holy war against {realm} and the House of {house}. Their priests bless the banners in every square.
breakaway: {pretender} raises the old standard of {old}. {towns} declare for him and the levies of the far provinces go over to the pretender's crown.

member: {realm} takes the cross against {house}, pouring {gold} gold from its chests into {men} fresh levies.
backer: {realm} declares for the pretender {pretender} and marches against {house}.
battleWon: {player} breaks the army of {foe} in the field. The enemy's resolve wavers.
battleLost: {player} is beaten by {foe} in the field, and the enemy takes heart.
boughtOff: {foe} takes {gold} gold of {house} and goes home. The others call it treachery.
funded: {player} pays {gold} gold into the royal chests: {men} more men answer the summons.
survived: The last crisis is over and the House of {house} still stands at the height of the world. They are already calling the years to come {age}.
The storm has broken against the walls of {house} and passed. Chroniclers name the age after them: {age}.
failed: The House of {house} could not hold what it had built. {realm} breaks apart, and the years to come are remembered as {age}.
The great crown of {house} falls into pieces. What follows is {age}.
fragment: {state} rises from the ruins of {realm}, ruled from {town}.
goldenEnd: {age} draws to its close. Men say they will not see such years again.
darkEnd: {age} lifts at last. The successor crowns are old now, and the House of {house} remembers what it was.
